name: Sell in May, buy in September month rule
author: DynamicSignalLab
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Monthly or daily bars; script uses month variable, so entry occurs on the first bar of September and exit on the first bar of May.
entry_long: Go long when the calendar month == 9 (September).
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Long-only; holds September through April. Exact first-bar timing depends on chart timeframe.
